lines: What if a trading bot simply couldn't run off with your money?

card.title: We've built trading agents on five chains.
card.sub: Base, Solana, X Layer, Arbitrum, and now Monad. Every time, the hard part wasn't the trading. It was trust.

lines: We're a small team that has built trading agents on five chains. Every time, the hard part wasn't the trading. It was trust, and we want to fix that.
Today's bots want your keys, or a balance they can move however they like. There's no limit you can see, and no brake when one goes wrong.

card.title: Agents can trade now. What's missing is control.
card.sub: Models read markets and place orders. Nobody has made them safe to hand money to.

lines: AI agents can now read markets and place orders. What's missing is control: who holds the money, and who can stop them.
XORR does three things. Hire a council of AI agents that vote on every trade. Limit them with a permission the chain enforces. And stop them, with one hold.

card.title: Final in half a second, so the council votes and fills together.
card.tag: TX HASHES IN THE PORTAL FORM

lines: On Monad, a block is final in about half a second, so the council can vote and fill together. And it's live on testnet: verified contracts, council rounds filled on Perpl, and the stop, each with its transaction.

card.title: People who want an agent to trade, without handing it their money.
card.sub: We reach them through Monad's testnet community, council replays anyone can share, and traders already on Perpl and Kuru.

lines: It's for people who want an agent to trade for them, without handing it their money. We'll reach them through Monad's testnet community, council replays anyone can share, and traders already on Perpl and Kuru.

card.title: A council of AI agents trades for you on Monad, and one hold stops it on chain.
